summary: Iter146 verification: separate Residents Log (blue-themed), stray_home detection, org-wide bulk resident badges, resident wallet_badge persistence, security_checkpoint package refactor. 78/78 backend pytest passed (69 baseline + 9 new). All frontend testids present and rendering correctly.

issues: Could not visually confirm the per-row blue 'Inside' badge color because no resident-scan rows existed during test. Backend payload + code path verified. Header pill colors (entries today, inside now) render correctly in blue/green.

critical_code_review_comments: security_checkpoint/__init__.py is 949 lines — still above the 700-line guideline. Main agent already flagged this for future refinement; suggest splitting endpoints by concern (scan/handoff/logs/checkpoints CRUD) next iteration.

/api/badges/list endpoint applies a campus filter that excludes bulk-issued resident wallet_badges from the response (verified — DB has 7 is_resident=true rows, /badges/list returned 0). Not a regression for iter146 (data persistence is correct), but worth tracking: consumers wanting to see resident badges in admin listing currently can't.

Frontend wallet badge token surface: members detail endpoint does not return wallet_badge_token; only /badges/list does. Acceptable but worth documenting for future testers (we used direct DB read to verify persistence).
seed_data_creation: TEST_Iter146_HOMEA_*, TEST_Iter146_HOMEB_*, TEST_Iter146 CP_A/CP_B, TEST_Iter146 Resident * — fixtures self-cleanup via DELETE in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline is now 78 tests. The 4 suites previously in play (smoke + iter91 + iter141 + iter90 = 69) plus the new iter146 suite (9). _pair_session helper in iter146 uses /rotate-pin (admin) → /checkpoint/pair (no auth, must include mode:'security'). Frontend stores device session at localStorage.checkpoint_session+checkpoint_mode+checkpoint_meta — paired-console UI is only visible when these are set. The wallet_badge resident-flags verification uses direct mongo read because /badges/list applies a campus filter that hides bulk-issued resident badges.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Verified: (1) Stray-home: backend stamps event.stray_home={id,name,is_restricted} when resident.resident_location_id != checkpoint.location_id, and frontend renders amber pill 'Resident of <name> (restricted)' via cp-stray-home testid. (2) Residents-log: device and admin endpoints both return envelope {date, rows, counts:{visitors_entered, residents_entered, …}, include_residents:false} with rows filtered to subject_type=='resident'. (3) Org-wide bulk: location_id='all' sweeps every restricted location, second call returns 0 created / all existing (idempotent). (4) wallet_badge: is_resident=true + resident_location_id + resident_location_name confirmed in DB. (5) Refactor: __init__.py=949 lines (was 1304); _common.py and ocr.py exist; legacy imports still work.
